name: Ring of Chastisement
body:
Aura faint evocation; CL 1st; Slot ring; Price 900 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

On command, you may use the spell chastisement as a swift action.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells chastisement; Cost 450 gp
